title: Stolen Lands Rumor
note: A rumor heard at Oleg's, a tavern, or from a traveler — a lead toward authored content (seeds the deck, points at a hex/cluster). Some are true, some exaggerated, some bait (Player != PC knowledge). Pair a hit with the matching cluster's location tag.

entries.value: The Stag Lord rules a fort on the Tuskwater; his gaze is death and his bandits are everywhere
Bandits camp along the Thorn River — a hard woman called Kressle leads them
Kobolds (the Sootscales) raid from caverns in the hills; something's twisted them lately
The fey of the Narlmarches play cruel pranks on travelers who don't show respect
A monstrous boar — 'Tuskgutter' — has gored more than one hunter in the Greenbelt
Candlemere, the tower-island on the mere, is cursed; lights move there at night
An old hermit (or a mad one) living in the wilds knows every trail and secret
There's a lost cache / buried treasure somewhere out in the Greenbelt
A trapper named Falgrim went missing; there may be a bounty
Pitax to the southwest is stirring; King Irovetti has no love for newcomers
An overgrown temple to Erastil stands in the woods, its blessing lost
Tatzlwyrms (two-headed dragon-kin) den near a river crossing
Trolls are said to gather deeper in the forest — a brutish lord among them
The Sootscale kobolds believe themselves cursed by a relic and a false god
That braggart Tartuccio holds his own charter and means to beat you to a kingdom
A noble or merchant offers coin for a specific beast slain or item recovered
A river crossing (Nettles' ford) is haunted — the ferryman is not what he seems
Mites or mitflits infest the roots of an ancient sycamore tree
Will-o'-wisps drift over the mere, feeding on fear
The swordlords of Restov play their own game; your charter is a piece on someone's board
